definitions.explanation: One of the three basic states of matter, in which a substance maintains a fixed shape and volume. Contrasts with liquid and gas.

examples.japanese: {氷|こおり}は{水|みず}の{固体|こたい}だ。
examples.english: Ice is the solid form of water.

examples.japanese: {物質|ぶっしつ}の{状態|じょうたい}は{固体|こたい}、{液体|えきたい}、{気体|きたい}の3つに{分|わ}けられる。
examples.english: The states of matter are divided into three: solid, liquid, and gas.

examples.japanese: {温度|おんど}が{下|さ}がると、{液体|えきたい}は{固体|こたい}に{変|か}わる。この{変化|へんか}を{凝固|ぎょうこ}という。
examples.english: When the temperature drops, a liquid changes into a solid. This change is called solidification.

notes:
USAGE NOTES:
{固体|こたい} is a scientific term used in physics, chemistry, and everyday language when discussing states of matter.

RELATED TERMS:
- {液体|えきたい} (liquid)
- {気体|きたい} (gas)
- {固体|こたい}・{液体|えきたい}・{気体|きたい} is the standard order when listing the three states

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {個体|こたい} (same reading, different kanji) means an individual organism — do not confuse

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {固体|こたい}{燃料|ねんりょう} (solid fuel)
- {固体|こたい}から{液体|えきたい}に{変|か}わる (change from solid to liquid)
- {固体|こたい}の{状態|じょうたい} (solid state)
